gate_explanation: Each of 11 synthetic cases runs twice per platform. Compare source edit distance AND character-count delta to the imperfect NEON baseline; neither may be worse. Keep cross-ISA differences in the report. Blank output must stay blank. No additional numeric error allowance is introduced.
known_variants: The terminal source contains go test ./...; the ARM reference misses the first dot, while x86 may miss the last. Both have one missing dot, at different positions. This is not a claim of perfect OCR or bit-identical cross-ISA output.

failed_iterations.reason: Windows raw ZIP test separator normalization; x86 terminal differed from the imperfect ARM baseline.
Known x86 difference retained in diagnostics; Windows inference completed but conhost remained.
Four Unix targets passed; HideWindow/CREATE_NO_WINDOW alone did not remove the Windows console host.

windows_final_fix: Both Go executables use PE32+ GUI subsystem (-H=windowsgui), plus a no-window worker launch flag. Keep zero residual child-process checks; do not ignore conhost. All stdio operations remain headless.
not_verified: Real WebView, keyboard/IME, clipboard, permissions and multi-monitor interaction on any platform
